title: AISU 50ml Shortfill – Green Apple
description:
Aisu’s signature menthol base is blended with a refined combination of fresh green apples. Aisu Green Apple is bursting with aromatic Apple flavor notes that are just the correct intensity for a sharp and constantly refreshing flavour making it ideal for an all-day vape.
AISU Green Apple has 70%VG / 30%PG for maximum flavour enhancement and dense clouds and comes in 60ml bottle with space for a nicotine shot
70% / 30% | VG / PG
